scientific_integrity: Builds explicitly on the finite isoperimetric feasibility criterion of Rajput, Jagatti and Rajan (2026) and the classical Harper theorem. Computations only corroborate finite examples; no independent priority check is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary Hamming metric, two-valued functions and arbitrary injective nonsystematic encoders; fixed s as t tends to infinity; first-order only; no full-message error protection; possible implicit earlier asymptotic counterpart.
title: Sharp Gaussian-quantile asymptotics for fixed-redundancy function-correcting codes
